name: Nonda Nanao
source:
The protagonist's grand mother in law. Her husband has already passed away.

Although she is still the landlord in name, she leaves all management of the ryokan to her daughter and her husband.

She looks younger than her age and often receives remarks about it. She still has a libido.

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_006/chara_2.html]official site[/url]]
